title: Amendment 1: Questions and Answers - Phoenix Area Indian Health Service Facilities Dental Equipment PM and Repair Services
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.PHOENIX AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
description_text: The contractor shall maintain and service the dental equipment in accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) requirements and recommendations. All scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, inspections, and repair services shall be performed in accordance with the requirements and standards set by the The Joint Commission and other regulatory agencies listed in Section R – Conformance Standards. SEE ATTACHMENTS FOR INFORMATION AND SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS.
